The problem

A warm meal is hard to get away from a kitchen.

You cook good food at home, then eat it cold at work. The microwave has a line, if there is one at all. On site, in a truck, or on a short break, there is often no way to heat anything.

So lunch becomes a cold sandwich, an expensive takeaway run, or food you just skip. The meal you packed deserves better than that.

  • No microwave, or a long line for the one there is.
  • Leftovers that taste flat and cold by midday.
  • Money spent on takeaway because home food will not reheat.

Rechargeable heating

Charge it. Take it. Heat anywhere.

HeatHaul heats on a built-in rechargeable battery, not a wall outlet. Charge it by USB at home or overnight, then unplug it and carry it with you. When you are ready to eat, switch on the heat — the box does the rest, wherever you are.

How it works

Three steps, in order.

1

Charge before use

Plug the USB cable in and charge the 7200mAh battery. Most people charge it overnight, like a phone.

2

Add prepared food

Put food that is already cooked — leftovers, meal prep or takeaway — into the steel container and close the lid.

3

Select heat & wait

Pick your temperature on the display and let the box heat. Open the lid at break time and eat it warm.

FAQ

Short answers, in plain words.

Does it need to stay plugged in?
No. Charge the battery first, then unplug it. HeatHaul heats on its 7200mAh rechargeable battery, so you can use it at your desk, on site, or in a vehicle with no outlet nearby.
Do I need to add water?
No. HeatHaul uses direct heating in the steel container. There is no water to add and no steam setup — just put the food in, close the lid, and select your heat.
How much food does it hold?
The container holds 900ml — about one full meal. Rice, meat and vegetables, or pasta and sauce, fit in one container with the lid closed.
Can it be washed?
Yes. The 304 stainless steel container lifts out, so you wash the container in the sink with warm soapy water. Do not submerge the main box or its battery and display — wipe the box clean instead.
Does it cook raw food?
No. It heats food that is already cooked. Pack leftovers or meal prep in the morning and eat them warm at break time.
